Job description:
Job Title: Senior Industrial Artificial Intelligence - Vibration Analysis
Job Description: We are looking for a creative specialist proficient in the fields of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and equipment vibration analysis to join our Predictive Maintenance (PdM) team. The goal of this role is to design, develop, and implement intelligent models for the early detection of defects, prediction of failures, and optimization of maintenance strategies in rotating machinery (pumps, compressors, turbines, fans, gearboxes, electric motors, and ...) using vibration data and other process parameters. Key Responsibilities:
Advanced Vibration Signal Analysis: Develop Machine Learning and Deep Learning models: Design Anomaly Detection models, Fault Classification, Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Prediction, and automatic detection of common defect severity (unbalance, misalignment, looseness, bearing failure, gear failure, resonance, and ...) using CNN, RNN, LSTM, Transformer, Autoencoder, and Transformer-based methods. Design Data Pipelines: Feature Engineering, Validation, and Interpretation: Close collaboration with Vibration Analysts to validate model outputs based on ISO standards (such as ISO 10816, ISO 13373, ISO 13374) and the physical logic of defects. Required Technical Expertise (Combination of Two Main Areas):
A) Expertise in Vibration Analysis and Rotating Equipment (Domain Expertise): Complete mastery of vibration theory and concepts: Natural frequency, resonance, mass-spring-damper, mode shape, critical speed. Deep understanding of rotating machine defects and the vibration pattern of each defect across the frequency and time waveform: Unbalance (static, dynamic, coupled), Misalignment (angular, parallel), Mechanical Looseness and Foundation Weakness, Rolling Bearing Failures (4-phase failure, wear analysis, Spike Energy), Gear Failure (Gear Mesh Frequency, Sidebands), Electronic Motor Defects (non-uniform air gap, Rotor Bar, Eccentricity), Cavitation, and Impact in Pumps. Mastery of Specialized Vibration Analysis Tools: Experience working with software such as Bently Nevada System 1, Emerson AMS Machinery Manager, SKF @ptitude Analyst, ADRE, or their equivalents. Familiarity with International Standards: ISO 10816 (Vibration Severity Assessment), ISO 7919 (Vibration Axis), ISO 13373 (Condition Monitoring), ISO 13374 (Data Exchange). Familiarity with Sensors and Data Collectors: Accelerometers, Displacement Probes (Eddy Current), Speed Sensors, appropriate installation and positioning of measurement points.
Certified Vibration Analysis (VA CAT II/III according to ISO 18436 or equivalent) is considered a major advantage.
B) Expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI/ML & Data Science): Advanced Programming: Mastery of Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn) and familiarity with MATLAB. Deep Learning: Mastery in using PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras for designing Deep Learning models on time-series and signal data. Digital Signal Processing: Designing Digital Filters (FIR/IIR), windowing, Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), Wavelet Transform, Hilbert-Huang Transform, Noise Reduction.
Classical Machine Learning: SVM, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM) for classification and regression tasks, dimensionality reduction methods (PCA, t-SNE).
Anomaly Modeling: Familiarity with Isolation Forest, One-Class SVM, Deep Autoencoders (LSTM-AE, CNN-AE), and Generative models for vibration data.
Managing Large Time-Series Data: Working with suitable databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, MongoDB) and industrial protocols (OPC-UA, MQTT).
MLOps and Software Development: Version Control (Git), Containerization (Docker), API Development (FastAPI/Flask), and familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML).
Eligibility Requirements: Education: Minimum Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering (Solid Mechanics/Dynamics), Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or related fields. (Interdisciplinary education is a competitive advantage). Work Experience: Minimum 3 to 5 years of practical experience in vibration analysis of rotating equipment in the industry (Oil, Gas, Petrochemical, Steel, Cement, Power Plants) and at least 2 years of experience in developing AI models for industrial problems. Proven ability to present projects where AI has been used for automatic detection of vibration defects (Submission of samples, papers, or portfolio is mandatory). Strong communication skills for collaboration with multidisciplinary teams (Instrumentation technicians, Reliability engineers, Plant managers) and presenting findings in simple terms. Personality Traits: Problem-solving mindset and interest in working in industrial and field environments (site visits to factories). High accuracy in data analysis and validation against physical realities. Up-to-dateness and a passion for continuous learning in both AI and condition monitoring.
Collaboration Advantages: Opportunity to work on real and challenging industrial problems, access to massive datasets and advanced sensors, and a key role in transforming maintenance from a reactive to a predictive approach.

Company description:
Rayan Kavoosh Ettela'at Madar (Rakam), an enterprise focused on the extraction and analysis of data. Our expertise lies in various fields including data behavior, text, image, and video analysis, which allows us to extract deep insights from complex data. With specialized experience in working with time-series data, we help our clients discover hidden patterns in this type of data and apply them for strategic decision-making. The company's cybersecurity department assists various organizations and companies across the country by employing experienced and skilled specialists and utilizing modern, internationally standardized methods in penetration testing to improve the security of their infrastructures and reduce the risk of cyberattacks on internet assets. Industrial automation is another capability of Rakam, and by combining process engineering knowledge with artificial intelligence expertise, we have provided transformative products in the mining and steel industry. Furthermore, we have been active in numerous projects in the fields of Industry 4.0, mining, and steel, where we have helped provide innovative solutions and increase productivity in these sectors. At Rayan Kavoosh Ettela'at Madar (Rakam), we are committed to providing data-driven solutions that not only help you face your business challenges but also enable you to stay ahead of your competitors.
